title: The Black Arrow: A Tale of the Two Roses
sourceTitle: The Black Arrow: A Tale of the Two Roses
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description: "The Black Arrow: A Tale of the Two Roses" by Robert Louis Stevenson is a historical adventure novel first serialized in 1883.
longDescription: Set during England's Wars of the Roses, it follows young Richard Shelton as he uncovers the truth about his father's murder.

authorInfo.bio: Robert Louis Stevenson was a Scottish novelist, essayist, poet and travel writer. He is best known for the novels Treasure Island (1883), Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde (1886), and Kidnapped (1886) and for the poetry collection A Child's Garden of Verses (1885).
